validity.researcher_notes: The PNGRB NGPL MIS register (May 2026 edition, Sr. No. 15) gives authorised length 58.0 km and operating length 57.0 km for 'Low Pressure Gujarat Gas Grid' / GSPL — matching the sheet's 58.00 km to the register's whole-km printing precision. This is a REGULATOR origin, independent of whatever produced the drawn route geometry, and it already anchors the staged Length [ref] fill for this row in the register-crosswalk batch (sheet_row 497, same value, unchanged). Given that independent corroboration, the 158 km geodesic length of the drawn route (ratio 2.73) is the more likely defect: either the geojson traces a longer corridor than the authorised Eklera–Hazira alignment, or it includes extraneous/looped segments. I could not find a public as-built trace to propose a replacement geometry, so I am not proposing new coordinates (standing rule: never fabricate a route) — flagging for human review of the existing geojson instead.
